name: After § 26
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 26c. Calls on the Commission to come forward with a revised proposal for the next MFF that includes a strengthened, clearly designated budget for the CAP, which should fully take account of inflationary pressure and remain separate from other EU policies, in order to preserve the essential nature of the CAP and provide long-term stability and predictability for farmers;
